theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_multiplier_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (g : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable F ν → IsCompact K → (∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 0) → Continuous f → (∀ k, Continuous (g k)) → TendstoUniformly g f atTop → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, g k x * F x ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x * F x ∂ν))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
